title: Zoning text change for Sojourner Truth-Mapes project, Bronx
summary: This application would amend the city's Zoning Resolution to establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for the Sojourner Truth-Mapes Rezoning in the Crotona neighborhood of the Bronx, Community District 6. It pairs with a related zoning map amendment to enable new residential and mixed-use buildings at 2136 Crotona Parkway and at East 182nd Street and Mapes Avenue. The Council's Land Use Committee recommended approval on October 6, 2026.
